about.tagline: Leading Higher Education & Career Consultancy in Central India
about.mission: To empower students across Madhya Pradesh with accessible, certified, and transparent university degrees, technical diplomas, and job-oriented skill training.
about.history: PKC Education Learning Institute & Consultancy was established in 2011 in Chhatarpur (M.P.) with a vision to guide youth towards authorized degrees and employment. Over 15 years, we have assisted more than 18,500 students in undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma admissions.
